items.title: How many valid copies does one leaked secret accumulate before rotation?
items.description: At Kelvin Metrics, the password sat live for about 0.75 hours (45 minutes) before anyone rotated it. In that window, ordinary background activity — CI runs pulling the repo, forks, clone caches — kept making new copies of the value, every one of which stayed valid even after the file was deleted from the latest commit. Drag hours-until-rotation and copies-created-per-hour to see why 'rotate first' beats 'delete the commit and move on.'
